settings.label: Tavily API key
settings.help: Create one at https://app.tavily.com. The free tier covers 1,000 searches a month.

settings.label: SearXNG server URL
settings.help: The address of your SearXNG server, e.g. http://localhost:8888. Its settings.yml must list json under search.formats.

settings.label: DeepSeek API key for search
settings.help: Create one at https://platform.deepseek.com. It can be the same key as your DeepSeek provider.

settings.label: Zhipu API key for search
settings.help: Create one at https://open.bigmodel.cn. It can be the same key as your GLM provider.

settings.label: Exa API key
settings.help: Create an API key at https://dashboard.exa.ai/api-keys
